current_status.from: Active as of 2026-09-23. Confirmed directly against the final adopted ordinance text (No. 2026/2028-10, county code Sec. 8.495): an earlier planning-commission draft (2026-PZ-9A4, 04/27/2026) specified 12 months, but WPR and the final adopted text (2026-PZ-9A6, dated 04/29/2026, published by the Town of Two Rivers as "adopted by the Manitowoc County Board 4-28-2026") confirm the County Board amended the term from 12 to 18 months on the floor before final passage. The 18-month term (from publication ~April 28-29, 2026, running to approximately late October 2027) had not lapsed as of 2026-09-23, and no repeal, rescission, or amendment was found in subsequent county records or news coverage.
